author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Corporate AI ads are getting completely out of control.

I came across an advertisement for GettInsured built around an obviously AI-generated emotional story: a struggling mom, sad kids, random podcasters crying on loop, changing voices, gibberish text, fake phone screens, inconsistent characters and basically every emotional advertising trope imaginable crammed into one video.

And the longer you watch it, the worse it gets.

This is what bothers me about AI-generated advertising. Someone still had to come up with the concept, prompt the fake hardship, generate the crying, create the struggling-parent storyline, stitch the clips together and deliberately use all of it to make viewers feel something so they'll click.

The AI didn't decide to emotionally manipulate anybody. A person told it what to make.

So in this video we're breaking down this AI advertisement frame by frame, looking at the weird generation errors, fake emotion, inconsistent voices, AI text, corporate marketing psy
title: CORPORATE AI ADVERTISEMENTS ARE OUT OF CONTROL!
